name: duplicate-emit-determinism
description: Refinement #8: same event emitted twice must produce identical canonical traces (modulo the runtime id stripped by canonicalizeTrace). This catches accidental hidden state accumulation in the substrate — anything that would cause the second emit's trace to differ structurally from the first. Cheap to run, high-signal for replay determinism: if it fails, something in EventBus or the governance path is reading state it shouldn't be.
